title: Campgrounds, Jefferson County Fairgrounds

services.name: Venue Rentals
services.desc: Our 32-acre property offers spacious buildings and flexible layouts designed to accommodate large gatherings with ease. Whether you’re hosting festivals, conferences, fundraisers, or multi-day celebrations, our venues provide the room, amenities, and support you need for a successful event. From workshops and club meetings to local celebrations and public programs, our variety of buildings can be tailored to fit gatherings of all sizes. The Fairgrounds provides welcoming, adaptable spaces where community can come together, connect, and thrive. With 32 acres of open grounds, covered areas, and versatile outdoor spaces, the Fairgrounds is ideal for markets, shows, fairs, and seasonal events.

blurb: We are a pet and family friendly Campground in beautiful Port Townsend, just a short walk from Fort Worden, the beach and a myriad of forested trails, with over 50 sites to choose from. The campground is operated by the Jefferson County Fairgrounds Association, a small non-profit dedicated to engaging our community in local agriculture and arts.
